title: Ghost-eye: A Novel

vibeProfile.oneLine: A girl's memories of a past life, memory and ecology, in Ghosh's new novel.

summary: Amitav Ghosh's return to fiction moves between 1960s Calcutta and present-day Brooklyn. In a strictly vegetarian Calcutta household, a girl named Varsha insists she remembers a past life in a riverside mud house, where she caught and cooked fish with another mother, and a psychologist begins studying her as a case of reincarnation. Half a century later, her old case file draws environmental activists into a search for her, because if her gifts are real they might help stop a coal plant threatening one of India's last wildernesses. Magical realism binding memory, fate and ecological crisis.
whyReadIt: Ghosh's first novel since Gun Island, a magical-realist tale of past lives, memory and a threatened wilderness. Haunting and timely.

funFacts.text: It is Amitav Ghosh's first novel since Gun Island in 2019.
